e: Respelling of ass representing a pronunciation with elision of the final consonant, which can occur in African-American Vernacular English. Later non-African American Vernacular English uses are perhaps derived from, or influenced by, -ahh (“-ass”). Equivalent to ass + -h.
q: In any given performance, their tosses and spins and leaps elicit oohs and ahhs from children and adults.
